indication: Age-related cataract, LOCS III nuclear opalescence grade 2-3; eyes below the ECD inclusion minimum, with poor mydriasis, previous ocular surgery or trauma excluded

groups.description: Microcoaxial phacoemulsification and IOL with a self-made anterior chamber maintainer (bent 22-gauge irrigation tip through the side port, bottle 70 cm) keeping continuous irrigation when instruments leave the eye; investigational device arm
Standard microcoaxial phacoemulsification and IOL without the anterior chamber maintainer

series.baseline_label: Preop. = preoperative ECD of the operated eye (EM-3000 specular microscope)
series.notes: mean ± SD; column header 'eyes = 121' (eyes completing the 3-month follow-up); 1 week = 7 days

notes: Prospective comparative study (May 2020 to May 2021), single surgeon; allocation by use of the self-made chamber maintainer, randomization not described. 140 eyes were enrolled per group; 121 (irrigation) and 127 (non-irrigation) completed 3 months and form the analysed groups; the 19 and 13 eyes lost to follow-up are not in the tables.
Visit times follow the table and abstract (1 week, 1 month, 3 months); Methods section 2.8 lists the postoperative ECD assessment at 1 day, 1 month and 3 months.
Role assignment: the self-made anterior chamber maintainer is the investigational device (treated); the non-irrigation arm is standard phacoemulsification (control).
